about: Painted Frontier (Style Lab style 3) on the tutorial island only: what Tools/Unreal/build_island_painted.py apply sets, over the lab's own numbers in Tools/Unreal/painted_look.py. Run apply again after changing anything here; undo puts the island back. Colours are linear RGB unless written '#rrggbb' (sRGB, as the lab gives them).

lights.about: Properties a lighting state never writes, by target (sun, skyLight, atmosphere, fog: the island's Sun, SkyLight, SkyAtmosphere and HeightFog), as the Python property names. light_color is the light's colour filter (linear here, stored as sRGB): the sun's stays at its Day temperature (5300 K) and is warmed by the filter toward the lab's #ffe0ae; the sky light's goes blue-violet, the lab's shade. lower_hemisphere_color is the warm bounce from the ground (the lab's #c89060 under its sky).

post.about: The PaintedPost volume (above IslandPost). volume: post process settings by Python name (lists are Vector4s), each turned on; the exposure bias comes from exposureBias. The lab's grade: saturation 1.14, contrast 1.07, a warm gain (#fffaf0) and a violet lift (#0c0816) in the shadows, gentle bloom; the shadows' gain carries the blue-violet into cast shadows, which the materials can't see. AO numbers only matter on High and Epic (Medium has no SSAO). material: the screen pass (M_PaintedPost: painted edges, vibrance, the violet vignette); false drops it and uses the engine's vignette. screen: changes over painted_look.POST (edges, vibrance, vignette).

sky.about: Changes over painted_look.SKY (the lab's sky). The island floats: below the horizon is the void, so the ground colour is the haze's blue, not the lab's earth. skyOpacity 1 paints the whole sky on the dome; 0 lays only the clouds over the engine's atmosphere.

terrain.about: Changes to M_Terrain's painted values ({scalars: {...}, vectors: {...}}, over painted_look.ground_params()).

water.about: The pond: the lab's flat teal (#2f9fae) at this share (Unreal's water also takes the sky's reflection), and its roughness.

roles.about: Changes to the lab's options for a role (wood, rock, stone, metal, bark, foliage, grass, fabric, paper, ground, other), keys as painted_look.lab_surface() makes them: blur, saturation, contrast, value, hue, tint ['#rrggbb', amount], roughness, specular, rim ['#rrggbb', power, strength], hook {...} (replaced whole).

materials.about: Changes for one shared material's painted instance, by the shared material's name: {"MI_HouseTrim": {"vectors": {"PaintAdjust": [1.5, 1.6, 1.1, 0]}}}.

state.about: Off: the lighting state Day stays the default, as Looter.World.Lighting.Levels requires of the island. On: the lab's own sun (bearing 165, 42 degrees up: late morning), a warmer sun and a brighter sky light, written into the lights and Day alike; that test fails until it allows the island a painted Day (a C++ change). With it on, set lights.sun.light_color back to [1, 1, 1].
